raw.rationale: Clioquinol is a lipophilic metal chelator (Cu/Zn/Fe) with known cytotoxicity at low micromolar concentrations, but PRISM single-point screens show most compounds are selective for no lineage; its weak OPRK1 activity and withdrawn clinical status provide no strong lineage-specific dependency signal. Thus probabilities are low across all lineages, with slight elevation for CNS (blood-brain barrier penetration and neuroblastoma/glioma metal dependency) and skin (topical history, melanoma metal addiction).
